field.label: Default provider
field.help: Which engine the dashboard widget and the scheduled runs use. Cloudflare needs no extra package and reports the Cloudflare PoP it measured against; Ookla uses speedtest-cli; iperf3 measures raw TCP throughput against a public iperf3 server.

field.label: Ookla server
field.help: Auto measures against the nearest server in Ookla's own live server list, which places this firewall from the connection itself. Choose Custom to always use one fixed server.

field.label: Ookla server ID
field.help: Numeric speedtest.net server ID, used when the choice above is Custom. Search the list below and press Use, or type an ID. The value is kept when you switch back to Auto.

field.label: iperf3 server
field.help: Auto detects which country this firewall is in and tries verified public iperf3 servers in that region, moving on while a server is busy. Choose Custom to always use your own server.

field.label: iperf3 host
field.help: Hostname or IP of your own iperf3 server, used when the choice above is Custom. The value is kept when you switch back to Auto.

field.label: iperf3 port
field.help: TCP port of your own iperf3 server. Empty means 5201. Public servers usually offer a range (5200-5209), one test at a time per port.

field.label: iperf3 streams
field.help: Parallel TCP streams, 1 to 16. Empty means 4, which is enough to fill a gigabit uplink.
